slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review states that registry offices in Comoros (prefectures and communes) record births in paper état civil registers and forms, with no routine digital system at rural offices and the Amecc digitisation plan not deployed at rural points of service; the document gives no date for the statement, so its published date is used.

systems.tiers: Plan validated in 2026; described as national ambition or pilot stage, not deployed at rural points of service
